audience: Codex operators tracking stable CLI releases and operator-facing surfaces
candidate_text:
Codex CLI 0.140.0 stable is out.

Release notes: `/usage`, durable `/goal`, session deletion, `/import`, unified @ mentions, managed Bedrock auth, MCP OAuth secret storage, and SQLite recovery.

Source: https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.140.0

Usage + goals:

- `/usage` adds daily, weekly, and cumulative token activity
https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27925

- `/goal` preserves long text and images, including remote app-server sessions
https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27508

Session lifecycle:

Permanent deletion reached CLI, TUI, and app-server `thread/delete`, with confirmation safeguards and subagent cleanup.

https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/25018
https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27476

Import + composer:

`/import` selectively brings setup, project config, and recent chats from Claude Code. Typing `@` now opens unified mentions for files, plugins, and skills by default.

https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27071

Auth/MCP operator notes:

0.140.0 adds managed Bedrock API-key auth plus encrypted local storage for CLI and MCP OAuth credentials.

Reviewed examples:
https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27443
https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27539

Reliability fixes:

- corrupted SQLite state can be backed up and rebuilt
https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/26859

- MCP startup/OAuth/disabled-server handling improved
https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/25147
https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/27414

Lineage + caveat:

Stable compare is rust-v0.139.0 -> rust-v0.140.0.
https://github.com/openai/codex/compare/rust-v0.139.0...rust-v0.140.0

Release notes are source evidence; unreviewed PR details should stay release-note-scoped.

The stable release lineage gate selects rust-v0.139.0 -> rust-v0.140.0; GitHub compare metadata reports status=diverged, 194 ahead commits, 1 behind commit, and 194 total commits for that stable-to-stable window.
